tasks.title: Write an Email
tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: You are a university student living in a dormitory. Recently, you have noticed issues with the common area in your dormitory. You want to report this problem to the dormitory manager, Mr. Evans, and request a solution. Write an email to Mr. Evans.
bullets: Describe the issue with the common area.
Explain how this problem is affecting you.
Suggest a resolution for the problem.
tasks.subject: Internet connection issues in dormitory
